scope: Explicit Spot ↔ Futures internal transfer. Direct connected EOA / existing email wallet signing; no replacement wallet. External deposit/withdrawal and main/subaccount transfer are separate and still unavailable.

requirements: Exact positive amount, input precision and source maximum
Explicit confirmation; clear amount only after a reported success and a fresh two-account read

official_sources.account_cap_comment: assets[].maxWithdrawAmount: maximum amount for transfer out; root maxWithdrawAmount only for USDT is not used as other-asset cap.

official_sources.boundary: transactionHistory exposes server tranId; no documented original-clientTranId query/mapping was found. No speculative history recovery endpoint is called.

anonymous_public_evidence.policy: Dynamic anonymous whitelist; success/code/data envelope required, exact asset identifiers, unique rows. Not a private login BAPI.
Input/display metadata only. Identical duplicates accepted (live BONUSUSD duplicate); conflicts rejected. MSTRB missing in snapshot.

anonymous_public_evidence.source: Cached public website transfer component Jm store
anonymous_public_evidence.policy: At most eight decimals, fallback two for absent/zero input metadata. The app preserves API asset IDs; no display alias substitution. Never claim this is on-chain or guaranteed ledger precision.

anonymous_public_evidence.source: Cached public website funding API module

endpoint.authentication: V3 EIP-712 chain1666, monotonic microsecond nonce/user/signer; exact signed query bytes in form-urlencoded body, signature appended last. EOA uses its connected signer, no new wallet. Platform signer eligibility unverified.
endpoint.response: Only documented SUCCESS and positive int64 tranId is a known reply. Missing/malformed/nonterminal/error/timeout remains unresolved; one POST, no retry.

client_policy.no_automatic_private_requests: Entry alone never reads/signs/submits. Explicit read needs three wallet signatures: mode, Spot account, Futures full account. Changing selected direction/asset clears input/review and explicitly re-reads.
client_policy.source_limit: Spot balances[selected].free, never free+locked; Futures assets[selected].maxWithdrawAmount string, never walletBalance/availableBalance/root USDT value. Missing/negative source cap blocks; absent asset is unknown, not zero.
client_policy.permissions: Source canWithdraw and destination canDeposit both must be explicit true. Missing/false blocks; non-bool rejects payload.
client_policy.amount: Positive plain Decimal, at most 80 characters; compare exact maximum and website input precision. Max floors to step, never rounds up. No float money.
client_policy.confirmation: Review original wallet, direction, exact asset/amount, maximum and original clientTranId. Fresh three-signature re-read compares selection, input policy, balances, selected maximum, permissions and mode. Account/Spot stream event including same-time replay, shared mutation epoch, scope/expiry change invalidates. Then one POST signature, durable prewrite, final scope/lifetime checks.
client_policy.signatures: Initial read3 + confirmation fresh read3 + POST1 + final mode/two-account read3 = typical full flow10; no hidden continuation.
client_policy.known_reply: Persist original server tranId before final read, even after stop/route exit/logout/provider disposal. Separately read both accounts and mode; refresh shared balance snapshots, then remove only corresponding record and clear input. Failure retains amount/reply for explicit read-only recovery.
client_policy.unknown_reply: Retain original client ID/nonce and block new transfer/order/configuration/Rebalance submissions for that wallet. No replay, deletion or success inference from balances. No documented original-clientTranId query: in-app resolution of truly unknown result remains unavailable. Contact platform with original identifiers; do not guess transactionHistory mapping.
client_policy.lock_boundary: Shared new-submission/settings lock; cancellation is outside this lock. Storage not ready/corrupt blocks new submissions; pending records isolated by wallet.
client_policy.history_boundary: The existing external deposit/withdrawal history is not internal transfer history. This increment does not claim a full transfer-history view or on-chain receipt.
client_policy.presentation: English/Chinese catalogs, explicit stale/empty/permission/precision/limit/failure states, exact identifiers selectable, amount retained on failures; stop/route loss invalidates UI scope without erasing original response.

journal.content: Exact wallet/asset/amount/direction/clientTranId/nonce/preparedAt/optional immutable public tranId. No signature, secret or executable queue.
journal.writes: Startup read before first screen, serial operations, strict duplicate-key/field/integer/asset validation; temp flush and same-directory rename. Retained original terms/missing canonical data cannot silently clear memory. No temp promotion or corrupt-file overwrite.
journal.response_write_failure: Retain reply in process memory even on directory/read/write failure; valid reload merges into matching original durable record. Host tests do not prove phone power-loss durability; app-data wipe/uninstall and a failed response write followed by process loss remain limitations.
